insight: Acquired expert-call network Tegus for $930M in 2024; a June 2026 round at $7.5B nearly doubled its valuation, with $600M+ ARR.
name: AlphaSense
tagline: AI market intelligence — search and agentic deep research across premium financial content.
description: A market intelligence platform used by investment firms and corporations to search and analyze equity research, company filings, earnings calls, news, and the Tegus expert-call transcript library. Its AI layer spans Generative Search, a Deep Research agent that autonomously runs multi-step research across the corpus, and custom agents for repeatable workflows — with enterprise plans that fold in a customer's internal documents. Serves over 7,000 enterprise customers.

modelSupport.notes: Generative Search and Deep Research built on leading reasoning models.

edge: Pairs agentic deep research with licensed content rivals can't crawl — broker research, filings, and 200k+ Tegus expert-call transcripts.
